en.t: The monk raised the lantern and shone it ahead.

units.source_text: 要领到大门口，还有相当长一段路程。

en.t: There was still quite a long way to go before he could lead them to the main gate.

units.source_text: 但可以说是来这儿游览的唯一的情趣。

en.t: But one could say that this was the only real charm of coming here to look around.
